moworks.notes: Pill 140x44 outlined. Spinner r11, 3 px arc, round caps, rotating linear 0.7 s per turn; arc length breathes 0.7 ↔ 3.7 rad (sine, 0.7 s each way). 1.3-1.6 s the arc grows to a full circle (power2.inOut) and fades 1.6-1.7 s; at 1.6 s an accent disc r13 pops (back.out 0.25 s) on the same spot and a tick draws 1.7-1.95 s (power2.out). Label below 'processing' → 'done'. Reset 2.35-2.55 s, spinner back 2.5-2.8 s. Params: spin (0.7 s / vòng) · arc (0.7 ↔ 3.7 rad) · close (0.3 s) · pop (back.out 0.25 s) · at.
